user.title: Connect to NX Witness
user.description: Create a read-only NX Witness connection. {read_only_note}

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the NX Witness server.
data_description.port: Port the NX Witness server listens on (default 7001).
data_description.use_https: Connect to the server over HTTPS.
data_description.verify_ssl: Validate the server's TLS certificate. Disable for self-signed certificates.
data_description.auth_mode: Basic auth is read-only and preferred; session tokens create a login session on the server.
data_description.username: NX Witness account username. A read-only account is recommended.
data_description.password: Password for the NX Witness account.
data_description.motion_window_seconds: How far back to look when deciding whether motion is currently active.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to NX Witness

abort.already_configured: This NX Witness server is already configured.

data_description.enable_cameras: Create camera entities for the selected cameras.
data_description.enable_motion: Create motion binary sensors for the selected cameras.
data_description.enable_clips: Expose recent motion clips in the Home Assistant media browser.
data_description.enabled_camera_ids: Select which cameras the integration should expose.
data_description.motion_window_seconds: How far back to look when deciding whether motion is active.
data_description.motion_period_type: Choose 'Motion' for server-side motion detection, or 'Recording' if your cameras use in-camera / analytics-based detection.
data_description.scan_interval_seconds: How often to refresh device, layout, and wall data.
data_description.default_stream: NX Witness stream profile to use by default.
data_description.default_stream_format: Format used for live stream proxy requests.
data_description.default_stream_resolution: Resolution used for live streams and snapshots.
data_description.clip_format: Format used for media browser clips.
data_description.clip_fps: Frame rate requested for media browser clips.

get_stored_files.name: Get stored files
get_stored_files.description: Read stored files from the NX Witness server without modifying anything.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Target NX Witness config entry. Required when multiple entries exist.

get_layouts.name: Get layouts
get_layouts.description: Return read-only layout metadata from the NX Witness server.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Target NX Witness config entry. Required when multiple entries exist.

include_layout_items.name: Include layout items
include_layout_items.description: Include the per-layout item list in the response.

get_video_walls.name: Get video walls
get_video_walls.description: Return read-only video wall metadata from the NX Witness server.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Target NX Witness config entry. Required when multiple entries exist.

get_video_wall_render_plan.name: Get video wall render plan
get_video_wall_render_plan.description: Expand a video wall into layouts and tiles so a Lovelace card can render it.

video_wall_id.name: Video wall ID
video_wall_id.description: Identifier of the video wall to expand.
